questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: What is identity and access management (IAM)?

options.A: The set of policies, processes and technologies used to create, manage, authenticate and control digital identities and their access rights

questions.explanation: IAM is the set of policies, processes and technologies used to create, manage, authenticate and control digital identities and their access rights.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: What is identity theft in the context of digital identity?

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: What precautions should be followed while using Aadhaar?

options.A: Share Aadhaar details only when legally or operationally required; use masked Aadhaar or VID where accepted; never disclose OTPs or PINs; check authentication notifications; and use official UIDAI channels for services

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: What makes a strong password?

options.A: A strong password is long, unique and difficult to guess. Prefer a long passphrase or randomly generated password; avoid reuse and predictable personal details
options.B: A short password that is easy to remember
options.C: A password that uses only your name and birthdate

questions.explanation: A strong password is long, unique and difficult to guess. Prefer a long passphrase or randomly generated password; avoid reuse and predictable personal details.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity

questions.subject: Cybersecurity

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Should an OTP, UPI PIN, ATM PIN or password be shared with bank staff or callers?

questions.subject: Cybersecurity

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: What should a user check before opening a link?

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: How should users handle email attachments?

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Why should devices be locked?

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: What is the benefit of enabling device encryption?

questions.subject: Cybersecurity

options.D: Apps should only be downloaded from social media links

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a function of a SIEM system?

options.A: Detecting and removing viruses
options.B: Collecting security logs from multiple sources

questions.explanation: A SIEM system collects and correlates security logs and events from multiple sources to support monitoring, alerting and investigation. Detecting and removing viruses is a function of antivirus software.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following best describes hashing?

options.A: Converting data into a fixed-length digest using a hash function
options.B: Converting readable plaintext into ciphertext using a key
options.C: Hiding sensitive values with realistic but non-sensitive values
options.D: Replacing direct identifiers with codes or tokens

questions.explanation: Hashing converts data into a fixed-length digest using a hash function. It is commonly used to check integrity.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following best describes a digital signature?

options.A: A cryptographic operation using public-key cryptography to verify origin and integrity and support non-repudiation
options.B: A scanned image of a handwritten signature

questions.explanation: A digital signature uses public-key cryptography to help verify the origin and integrity of an electronic message or document and support non-repudiation.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a characteristic of Aadhaar?

options.A: It is proof of Indian citizenship
options.B: It is a 12-digit random identity number
options.D: It is issued to residents of India after the prescribed enrolment and deduplication process

questions.explanation: Aadhaar is an identity number and is not proof of Indian citizenship.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following best describes a Virtual ID (VID) in Aadhaar?

options.A: A temporary, revocable 16-digit random number that can be used in place of the Aadhaar number

questions.explanation: VID is a temporary, revocable 16-digit random number that can be used in place of the Aadhaar number for authentication or e-KYC where supported.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following best describes masked Aadhaar?

options.A: A version in which the first eight digits of the Aadhaar number are concealed and only the last four digits are visible
options.B: A version in which the last eight digits are concealed
options.C: A version in which all digits are concealed
options.D: A version in which no digits are concealed

questions.explanation: Masked Aadhaar is a version in which the first eight digits of the Aadhaar number are concealed and only the last four digits are visible.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following best describes a passkey?

options.A: A phishing-resistant sign-in credential based on public-key cryptography, generally unlocked using a device PIN or biometric method
options.B: A type of password that is easy to remember
options.C: A physical key used to unlock a computer

questions.explanation: A passkey is a phishing-resistant sign-in credential based on public-key cryptography, generally unlocked using a device PIN or biometric method.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following best describes single sign-on (SSO)?

options.A: A user authenticates once and accesses multiple connected applications without separately signing in to each one
options.B: A user must sign in separately to each application
options.C: A user shares passwords across applications

questions.explanation: SSO allows a user to authenticate once and access multiple connected applications without separately signing in to each one, subject to the system's security controls.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following best describes federated identity?

options.A: Trusted organisations or services rely on an identity provider for authentication under agreed protocols and trust arrangements
options.B: Users create separate identities for each service

questions.explanation: Federated identity allows trusted organisations or services to rely on an identity provider for authentication under agreed protocols and trust arrangements.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a characteristic of a strong password?

options.A: It uses predictable personal details

questions.explanation: A strong password is long, unique and difficult to guess. Avoid reuse and predictable personal details.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is a safe practice for handling email attachments?

options.A: Open attachments only when expected and from a verified sender
options.C: Enable all macros to view the content
options.D: Forward attachments to friends without checking

questions.explanation: Users should open attachments only when expected and from a verified sender, scan files; avoid enabling macros; and confirm unusual requests through another channel.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is a safe practice for using public charging stations?

options.A: Prefer a wall charger and personal cable or a power bank
options.B: Use any available USB port without checking
options.D: Use public charging stations for all devices without caution

questions.explanation: The safest way to use public charging stations is to prefer a wall charger and personal cable or a power bank. Use a data-blocking adapter where appropriate and avoid approving unexpected data-access prompts.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is a safe practice for QR-code payments?

options.A: Scan only codes from trusted sources and verify the recipient and amount before authorising
options.B: Scan any QR code without checking
options.C: Enter your UPI PIN to receive money

questions.explanation: Users can protect themselves from QR-code fraud by scanning only codes from trusted sources, verifying the recipient and amount before authorising, rejecting unexpected collect requests and never entering a UPI PIN to receive money.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a step to take if a password is compromised?

options.A: Share the password with friends to verify
options.B: Change it immediately on the affected service
options.D: Review recovery details and account activity

questions.explanation: If a password is compromised, change it immediately on the affected service and anywhere it was reused; enable MFA; sign out other sessions; review recovery details and account activity; and contact the provider if access is lost. Sharing the password with friends is not a recommended step.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following best describes responsible disclosure?

options.A: Reporting a security vulnerability to the affected organisation or authorised coordinator in a controlled manner, allowing time for investigation and remediation before public disclosure
options.B: Publishing a vulnerability on social media immediately
options.C: Selling a vulnerability to the highest bidder
options.D: Ignoring a vulnerability and hoping no one finds it

questions.explanation: Responsible disclosure is the process of reporting a security vulnerability to the affected organisation or authorised coordinator in a controlled manner, allowing time for investigation and remediation before public disclosure.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following best describes cyber hygiene?

options.A: The routine practice of maintaining secure digital behaviour, such as updates, backups, strong unique passwords, MFA, cautious browsing and access reviews
options.B: The process of cleaning computer hardware

questions.explanation: Cyber hygiene is the routine practice of maintaining secure digital behaviour, such as updates, backups, strong unique passwords, MFA, cautious browsing and access reviews.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.topic: Important Indian Institutions, Laws and Initiatives
questions.chapter: Important Indian Institutions, Laws and Initiatives
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a function of CERT-In?

options.A: Issuing Aadhaar numbers
options.B: Collecting, analysing and disseminating information on cyber incidents

questions.explanation: CERT-In collects, analyses and disseminates information on cyber incidents; issues alerts and advisories; coordinates incident response; recommends emergency measures; and promotes security practices and awareness. Issuing Aadhaar numbers is a function of UIDAI.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.topic: Important Indian Institutions, Laws and Initiatives
questions.chapter: Important Indian Institutions, Laws and Initiatives
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a function of I4C?

options.A: Issuing Aadhaar numbers
options.B: Coordinating efforts to address cybercrime across States and Union Territories
options.C: Supporting law-enforcement agencies through platforms, analytics, training and capacity building
options.D: Coordinating cybercrime-related efforts under the Ministry of Home Affairs

questions.explanation: I4C coordinates efforts to address cybercrime across States and Union Territories and supports law-enforcement agencies through platforms, analytics, training and capacity building. Issuing Aadhaar numbers is a function of UIDAI.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.topic: Important Indian Institutions, Laws and Initiatives
questions.chapter: Important Indian Institutions, Laws and Initiatives
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a function of NCIIPC?

options.A: Issuing Aadhaar numbers
options.C: National nodal agency under Section 70A of the IT Act
options.D: Protecting computer resources whose incapacitation would have a debilitating impact on national security

questions.explanation: NCIIPC is the national nodal agency for protection of critical information infrastructure under Section 70A of the IT Act. Issuing Aadhaar numbers is a function of UIDAI.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.topic: Important Indian Institutions, Laws and Initiatives
questions.chapter: Important Indian Institutions, Laws and Initiatives
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a function of the Controller of Certifying Authorities (CCA)?

options.A: Issuing Aadhaar numbers
options.C: Overseeing the framework for digital signature certificates

questions.explanation: CCA licenses and regulates Certifying Authorities and oversees the framework for digital signature certificates under the IT Act. Issuing Aadhaar numbers is a function of UIDAI.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.topic: Important Indian Institutions, Laws and Initiatives
questions.chapter: Important Indian Institutions, Laws and Initiatives
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a function of the Cyber Swachhta Kendra?

options.A: Issuing Aadhaar numbers
options.D: Supporting detection and remediation of infected devices

questions.explanation: The Cyber Swachhta Kendra is the Government of India's botnet cleaning and malware analysis centre, which supports detection and remediation of infected devices and promotes cyber hygiene. Issuing Aadhaar numbers is a function of UIDAI.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.topic: Important Indian Institutions, Laws and Initiatives
questions.chapter: Important Indian Institutions, Laws and Initiatives
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a function of the National Informatics Centre (NIC)?

options.A: Issuing Aadhaar numbers
options.B: Providing digital infrastructure, networks, data-centre and e-governance technology support to government organisations
options.C: NIC-CERT supporting cybersecurity for NIC's constituency

questions.explanation: NIC provides digital infrastructure, networks, data-centre and e-governance technology support to government organisations; NIC-CERT supports cybersecurity for NIC's constituency. Issuing Aadhaar numbers is a function of UIDAI.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following correctly differentiates a virus from a worm?

options.A: A virus attaches to a host file/program; a worm can self-replicate and spread independently
options.B: A virus can self-replicate and spread independently; a worm attaches to a host file
options.D: A virus only affects mobile phones; a worm only affects computers

questions.explanation: Virus attaches to a host file/program; worm can self-replicate and spread independently.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following correctly differentiates a Trojan from ransomware?

options.A: A Trojan disguises malicious software as legitimate; ransomware blocks/encrypts data and demands payment
options.B: A Trojan blocks/encrypts data; ransomware disguises itself as legitimate
options.D: A Trojan only affects mobile phones; ransomware only affects computers

questions.explanation: Trojan disguises malicious software as legitimate; ransomware blocks/encrypts data and demands payment.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following correctly differentiates phishing from smishing?

options.A: Phishing uses deceptive communications broadly; smishing uses SMS/text messages
options.B: Phishing uses SMS/text messages; smishing uses deceptive communications broadly
options.D: Phishing uses voice calls; smishing uses websites

questions.explanation: Phishing uses deceptive communications broadly; smishing uses SMS/text messages.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following correctly differentiates vishing from pharming?

options.A: Vishing uses voice calls; pharming redirects a user to a fraudulent website
options.B: Vishing redirects a user to a fraudulent website; pharming uses voice calls
options.D: Vishing uses SMS; pharming uses email

questions.explanation: Vishing uses voice calls; pharming redirects a user to a fraudulent website.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following correctly differentiates DoS from DDoS?

options.A: DoS attack originates from one or limited sources; DDoS uses multiple distributed sources
options.B: DoS uses multiple distributed sources; DDoS originates from one source
options.D: DoS only targets web servers; DDoS only targets databases

questions.explanation: DoS attack originates from one or limited sources; DDoS uses multiple distributed sources.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following correctly differentiates encryption from hashing?

options.A: Encryption is reversible with a key; hashing is designed as a one-way digest
options.B: Encryption is one-way; hashing is reversible with a key
options.D: Encryption is used for integrity; hashing is used for confidentiality

questions.explanation: Encryption is reversible with a key; hashing is designed as a one-way digest.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following correctly differentiates authentication from authorisation?

options.A: Authentication verifies identity; authorisation grants or denies permissions
options.B: Authentication grants permissions; authorisation verifies identity
options.D: Authentication is for systems; authorisation is for humans

questions.explanation: Authentication verifies identity; authorisation grants or denies permissions.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following correctly differentiates confidentiality from integrity?

options.A: Confidentiality prevents unauthorised disclosure; integrity prevents unauthorised alteration
options.B: Confidentiality prevents unauthorised alteration; integrity prevents unauthorised disclosure
options.D: Confidentiality is about availability; integrity is about authenticity

questions.explanation: Confidentiality prevents unauthorised disclosure; integrity prevents unauthorised alteration.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following correctly differentiates IDS from IPS?

options.A: IDS detects and alerts; IPS can actively block malicious activity
options.B: IDS actively blocks malicious activity; IPS detects and alerts
options.D: IDS is a type of firewall; IPS is a type of antivirus

questions.explanation: IDS detects and alerts; IPS can actively block malicious activity.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following correctly differentiates data privacy from data security?

options.A: Privacy governs appropriate use and control of personal data; security protects data and systems from threats
options.B: Privacy protects data from threats; security governs appropriate use of personal data
options.D: Privacy is a technical measure; security is a legal concept

questions.explanation: Privacy governs appropriate use and control of personal data; security protects data and systems from threats.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity

options.B: CERT-In coordinates cybercrime response; I4C coordinates technical cyber incident response
options.D: CERT-In is under MHA; I4C is under MeitY

questions.explanation: CERT-In coordinates technical cyber incident response; I4C coordinates cybercrime response and law-enforcement support.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity

options.A: Aadhaar is a UIDAI-issued resident identity number; PAN is a tax-related identifier issued by the Income Tax Department
options.B: Aadhaar is a tax-related identifier; PAN is a resident identity number
options.D: Both are issued by the Income Tax Department

questions.explanation: Aadhaar is a UIDAI-issued resident identity number; PAN is a tax-related identifier issued by the Income Tax Department.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following correctly differentiates a digital certificate from a digital signature?

options.A: A certificate binds an identity to a public key; a digital signature is a cryptographic operation used to verify origin and integrity
options.B: A certificate is a cryptographic operation; a digital signature binds an identity to a public key
options.D: A certificate is used for encryption; a digital signature is used for decryption

questions.explanation: A certificate binds an identity to a public key; a digital signature is a cryptographic operation used to verify origin and integrity.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a type of malware?

options.A: Firewall

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a type of phishing?

options.A: Firewalling

questions.explanation: Firewalling is not a type of phishing. Spear phishing, whaling and smishing are types of phishing.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a component of data protection?

options.A: Indefinite storage of all data

questions.explanation: Data protection means applying legal, organisational and technical safeguards to personal or other important data throughout its collection, use, storage, sharing, retention and disposal. Indefinite storage is not a component of data protection.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a principle of the DPDP framework?

options.A: Indefinite data retention

questions.explanation: Key principles include lawful and transparent processing, purpose limitation, data minimisation, accuracy, storage limitation, reasonable security safeguards and accountability. Indefinite data retention is not a principle.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a stage of the 3-2-1 backup rule?

options.A: Keep all copies on the same storage media
options.B: Keep at least three copies of important data
options.C: Use two different types of storage media
options.D: Keep at least one copy off-site

questions.explanation: The 3-2-1 backup rule requires keeping at least three copies of important data, on two different types of storage media, with at least one copy off-site or otherwise isolated from the primary environment.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a type of cybercrime?

options.A: Software update

questions.explanation: A software update is a legitimate activity, not a cybercrime. Online financial fraud, cyberstalking and cyber extortion are types of cybercrime.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a function of the police in cybercrime cases?

options.A: Issuing Aadhaar numbers
options.D: Initiating legal action under applicable law

questions.explanation: Police receive complaints, register and investigate offences, collect digital evidence, coordinate with banks and service providers, identify suspects and initiate legal action under applicable law. Issuing Aadhaar numbers is a function of UIDAI.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a characteristic of a cyber asset?

options.A: It has no value
options.D: It can be a computer, server, mobile phone, network, database, application, account or digital record

questions.explanation: A cyber asset is any digital resource that has value and needs protection, such as a computer, server, mobile phone, network, database, application, account or digital record.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a component of cyberspace?

options.A: Physical office furniture

questions.explanation: Cyberspace is the interconnected digital environment formed by the internet, communication networks, computers, software, connected devices and the data exchanged through them. Physical office furniture is not a component of cyberspace.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT an example of a cyber threat actor?

options.A: A firewall

questions.explanation: A firewall is a security control, not a threat actor. Malicious insiders, nation-state groups and cybercriminals are examples of threat actors.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a common source of vulnerabilities?

options.A: Regular security patching

questions.explanation: A vulnerability is a weakness in software, hardware, configuration, process or human behaviour that can be exploited by a threat. Regular security patching reduces vulnerabilities rather than creating them.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a component of the attack surface?

options.A: Employee social media profiles of a competitor

questions.explanation: The attack surface is the total set of points through which an attacker could try to enter or extract data from a system, including devices, applications, accounts, networks and exposed services. A competitor's employee social media profiles are not part of the organisation's attack surface.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a goal of cybersecurity?

options.A: Maximising data collection

questions.explanation: The objective of cybersecurity is to preserve confidentiality, integrity and availability of information and systems, while supporting authenticity, accountability, privacy and continuity of services. Maximising data collection is not a goal.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a type of malware?

options.A: Firewall

questions.explanation: A firewall is a security tool, not malware. Ransomware, spyware and rootkit are types of malware.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a type of social engineering attack?

options.A: SQL injection

questions.explanation: SQL injection is a technical attack, not a social engineering attack. Phishing, vishing and smishing are social engineering attacks.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a type of password attack?

options.A: Pharming

questions.explanation: Pharming is a type of phishing that redirects users to a fraudulent website; it is not a password attack. Brute-force, dictionary and credential stuffing are password attacks.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a step in basic threat prevention for malware?

options.A: Disable all security software
options.B: Install software only from trusted sources
options.C: Keep operating systems and applications updated

questions.explanation: Malware infections can be reduced by installing software only from trusted sources; keeping operating systems and applications updated; using reputable endpoint protection; avoiding suspicious attachments and links; disabling unnecessary macros; and maintaining offline or protected backups. Disabling security software increases risk.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a sign of a phishing email?

options.A: Correct spelling and grammar throughout

questions.explanation: Phishing can be identified by checking the sender's full address, unexpected urgency, spelling or domain irregularities, requests for passwords or OTPs, suspicious attachments and links. Correct spelling and grammar alone do not indicate a phishing email.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a safe practice when using public Wi-Fi?

options.A: Conducting sensitive banking transactions without a VPN
options.B: Avoiding sensitive transactions on untrusted networks
options.C: Using trusted mobile data or a reputable VPN where appropriate

questions.explanation: Open public Wi-Fi may expose traffic to interception or rogue access points. Avoid sensitive transactions on untrusted networks; use trusted mobile data or a reputable VPN where appropriate; and verify HTTPS and network names.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a category of data?

options.A: Data in space

questions.explanation: Data can be categorised as data at rest, data in transit and data in use. 'Data in space' is not a recognised category.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a method of secure data disposal?

options.A: Moving the file to another folder

questions.explanation: Secure disposal makes data unrecoverable or inaccessible when it is no longer required, using approved deletion, sanitisation, destruction or cryptographic erasure methods. Moving a file to another folder does not make it unrecoverable.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a right of a Data Principal under the DPDP framework?

options.A: The right to demand indefinite retention of data
options.B: The right to access information about processing
options.C: The right to correction of data

questions.explanation: The DPDP Act recognises individual rights such as access, correction, erasure and grievance redressal. The right to demand indefinite retention of data is not recognised; storage limitation is a key principle.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a type of online financial fraud?

options.A: Software update notification

questions.explanation: A software update notification is a legitimate activity, not a financial fraud. UPI fraud, OTP scams and QR-code payment scams are types of online financial fraud.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a step a victim should take after an online financial fraud?

options.A: Delete all messages and transaction records
options.B: Call the national cyber financial fraud helpline 1930
options.C: Report on the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal
options.D: Contact the bank or payment provider through its official channel

questions.explanation: A victim should immediately call 1930, report on cybercrime.gov.in, contact the bank or payment provider through its official channel, preserve evidence and inform the police as appropriate. Deleting messages and transaction records destroys evidence.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a function of CERT-In?

options.A: Conducting criminal investigations
options.B: Collecting, analysing and disseminating information on cyber incidents

questions.explanation: CERT-In collects, analyses and disseminates information on cyber incidents; issues alerts and advisories; coordinates incident response; recommends emergency measures; and promotes security practices and awareness. Criminal investigations are conducted by law enforcement agencies.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a function of I4C?

options.A: Issuing cybersecurity advisories
options.B: Coordinating efforts to address cybercrime across States and Union Territories
options.C: Supporting law-enforcement agencies through platforms, analytics, training and capacity building
options.D: Coordinating cybercrime-related efforts under the Ministry of Home Affairs

questions.explanation: I4C coordinates efforts to address cybercrime across States and Union Territories and supports law-enforcement agencies through platforms, analytics, training and capacity building. Issuing cybersecurity advisories is a function of CERT-In.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a section of the IT Act related to cybercrime?

options.A: Section 80G

questions.explanation: Section 66C deals with identity theft; Section 66D deals with cheating by personation using computer resources; Section 66F addresses cyber terrorism. Section 80G is related to income tax deductions, not cybercrime.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a component of information security?

options.A: Marketing

questions.explanation: Information security is the protection of information and information systems against unauthorised access, use, disclosure, disruption, modification or destruction. The CIA triad consists of Confidentiality, Integrity and Availability. Marketing is not a component of information security.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a characteristic of the principle of least privilege?

options.A: Granting full administrative access to all users
options.B: Granting only the minimum permissions necessary
options.C: Granting permissions only for as long as required
options.D: Restricting access based on assigned tasks

questions.explanation: The principle of least privilege states that a user or process should receive only the minimum permissions necessary to perform its assigned task, and only for as long as required. Granting full administrative access to all users violates this principle.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a factor in MFA?

options.A: Something the user wants

questions.explanation: MFA requires two or more independent categories of evidence to verify identity, such as something the user knows, has or is. 'Something the user wants' is not an authentication factor.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a function of antivirus software?

options.A: Creating encrypted tunnels over a network

questions.explanation: Antivirus or anti-malware software detects, blocks, quarantines or removes malicious software using signatures, behaviour analysis and other detection techniques. Creating encrypted tunnels over a network is a function of a VPN.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a function of a VPN?

options.A: Detecting and removing viruses
options.B: Creating an encrypted tunnel over a network

questions.explanation: A VPN creates an encrypted tunnel over a network to protect traffic between endpoints. Detecting and removing viruses is a function of antivirus software.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a type of security assessment?

options.A: Marketing assessment

questions.explanation: Vulnerability assessment, penetration testing and security audit are types of security assessment. Marketing assessment is not a security assessment.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a stage of incident response?

options.A: Marketing

questions.explanation: The common stages of incident response are: Preparation; identification and analysis; containment; eradication; recovery; and post-incident review or lessons learned. Marketing is not a stage of incident response.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a function of a security policy?

options.A: Guaranteeing complete protection from all threats
options.C: Governing how an organisation protects information and technology assets
options.D: Providing an approved framework for security practices

questions.explanation: A security policy is an approved set of rules and responsibilities governing how an organisation protects information and technology assets. No policy can guarantee complete protection from all threats.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a benefit of a security awareness programme?

options.A: Eliminating the need for technical security controls
options.C: Encouraging users to follow security procedures
options.D: Encouraging users to report suspicious activity

questions.explanation: A security awareness programme educates users to recognise threats, follow security procedures and report suspicious activity. It does not eliminate the need for technical security controls.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a function of a security log?

options.A: Encrypting data at rest

questions.explanation: A security log is a time-stamped record of system, application, network or user events used for monitoring, troubleshooting, auditing and investigation. Encrypting data at rest is a separate security control.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a function of a SOC?

options.A: Developing marketing strategies

questions.explanation: A SOC is a team or facility that continuously monitors, detects, analyses and coordinates responses to cybersecurity events. Developing marketing strategies is not a function of a SOC.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a function of a SIEM system?

options.A: Removing malware from endpoints
options.B: Collecting security logs from multiple sources

questions.explanation: A SIEM system collects and correlates security logs and events from multiple sources to support monitoring, alerting and investigation. Removing malware from endpoints is a function of antivirus software.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a characteristic of hashing?

options.A: It is reversible with the correct key
options.B: It converts data into a fixed-length digest
options.C: It is commonly used to check integrity
options.D: It is designed to be one-way

questions.explanation: Hashing converts data into a fixed-length digest using a hash function. It is commonly used to check integrity; secure password storage uses specialised salted password-hashing methods. A cryptographic hash is designed to be one-way and is not decrypted to recover the original data.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a component of a digital signature?

options.A: A scanned image of a handwritten signature

questions.explanation: A digital signature uses public-key cryptography to help verify the origin and integrity of an electronic message or document and support non-repudiation. It is not a scanned image of a handwritten signature.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a component of PKI?

options.A: Antivirus software

questions.explanation: PKI is a framework of digital certificates, public-key cryptography, policies and trusted authorities used to establish and manage digital identities and secure communications. Antivirus software is not a component of PKI.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a component of digital identity?

options.A: A person's physical fingerprints stored on paper

questions.explanation: Digital identity is the collection of electronic attributes and credentials used to represent, identify or authenticate a person, organisation, device or service online. Physical fingerprints stored on paper are not part of digital identity.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a valid identifier?

options.A: A password

questions.explanation: An identifier is a value used to distinguish an entity, such as a username, customer number, email address or identity number. A password is a credential used to prove identity, not an identifier.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a valid credential?

options.A: A username

questions.explanation: A credential is evidence used to prove identity or a claim, such as a password, smart card, digital certificate, passkey or biometric-based authentication token. A username is an identifier, not a credential.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a characteristic of Aadhaar?

options.A: It is a 16-digit number
options.B: It is a 12-digit random identity number
options.D: It is issued to residents of India after the prescribed enrolment and deduplication process

questions.explanation: Aadhaar is a 12-digit random identity number issued by UIDAI to residents of India after the prescribed enrolment and deduplication process. It is not a 16-digit number; a Virtual ID (VID) is a 16-digit number.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a valid use of a Virtual ID (VID) in Aadhaar?

options.A: As proof of Indian citizenship
options.D: As a temporary, revocable alternative to the Aadhaar number

questions.explanation: VID is a temporary, revocable 16-digit random number that can be used in place of the Aadhaar number for authentication or e-KYC where supported. Aadhaar and VID are not proof of Indian citizenship.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a characteristic of masked Aadhaar?

options.A: It conceals the last four digits
options.B: It conceals the first eight digits
options.C: Only the last four digits are visible
options.D: It is a version of the Aadhaar number

questions.explanation: Masked Aadhaar is a version in which the first eight digits of the Aadhaar number are concealed and only the last four digits are visible.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a characteristic of DigiLocker?

options.A: User-uploaded scans are automatically issuer-authenticated
options.B: It enables users to access, store and share authentic digital documents
options.C: Documents issued by registered issuers can be verified through the platform
options.D: It is a Government of India digital document platform

questions.explanation: Documents fetched or issued by registered issuers can be verified through the platform; a user-uploaded scan is not automatically an issuer-authenticated document.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a characteristic of a passkey?

options.A: It is vulnerable to phishing
options.B: It is based on public-key cryptography
options.C: It is generally unlocked using a device PIN or biometric method
options.D: It is a phishing-resistant sign-in credential

questions.explanation: A passkey is a phishing-resistant sign-in credential based on public-key cryptography, generally unlocked using a device PIN or biometric method. It is designed to resist phishing, not be vulnerable to it.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a characteristic of SSO?

options.A: It requires users to sign in separately to each application
options.B: It allows a user to authenticate once
options.C: It provides access to multiple connected applications
options.D: It is subject to the system's security controls

questions.explanation: SSO allows a user to authenticate once and access multiple connected applications without separately signing in to each one, subject to the system's security controls.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a characteristic of federated identity?

options.A: It requires users to create separate identities for each service
options.B: It allows trusted organisations or services to rely on an identity provider
options.C: It operates under agreed protocols and trust arrangements

questions.explanation: Federated identity allows trusted organisations or services to rely on an identity provider for authentication under agreed protocols and trust arrangements. It does not require users to create separate identities for each service.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a characteristic of IAM?

options.A: It only applies to government organisations
options.B: It includes policies, processes and technologies
options.C: It is used to create and manage digital identities

questions.explanation: IAM is the set of policies, processes and technologies used to create, manage, authenticate and control digital identities and their access rights. It applies to organisations of all types, not only government organisations.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a safe practice for Aadhaar usage?

options.A: Sharing Aadhaar details freely on social media
options.B: Using masked Aadhaar or VID where accepted
options.D: Using official UIDAI channels for services

questions.explanation: Precautions include sharing Aadhaar details only when legally or operationally required; using masked Aadhaar or VID where accepted; never disclosing OTPs or PINs; checking authentication notifications; and using official UIDAI channels for services.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a characteristic of a strong password?

options.A: It is short and easy to remember

questions.explanation: A strong password is long, unique and difficult to guess. Prefer a long passphrase or randomly generated password; avoid reuse and predictable personal details.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a benefit of a password manager?

options.A: It eliminates the need for a master password
options.D: It reduces the need to remember or reuse passwords

questions.explanation: A password manager securely stores and generates unique passwords, reducing the need to remember or reuse them. Protect it with a strong master password and MFA.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following should NOT be shared with anyone, including people claiming to be bank, police, government or customer-care officials?

options.A: OTP, UPI PIN, ATM PIN or password

questions.explanation: OTP, UPI PIN, ATM PIN and passwords are authentication secrets that must not be shared with anyone, including people claiming to be bank, police, government or customer-care officials.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a safe practice before opening a link?

options.A: Relying only on a logo or display name

questions.explanation: Before opening a link, check the sender, domain spelling, context and destination URL. Do not rely only on a logo, display name or shortened link.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a safe practice for handling email attachments?

options.A: Enabling all macros to view the content
options.B: Opening attachments only when expected and from a verified sender
options.D: Confirming unusual requests through another channel

questions.explanation: Users should open attachments only when expected and from a verified sender, scan files; avoid enabling macros; and confirm unusual requests through another channel.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a benefit of device encryption?

options.A: It makes the device run faster
options.B: It helps protect stored information if a phone or computer is lost or stolen
options.C: It is especially effective when combined with a strong screen lock

questions.explanation: Device encryption helps protect stored information if a phone or computer is lost or stolen, especially when combined with a strong screen lock. It does not make the device run faster.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a reason to download apps from official stores?

options.A: Official stores guarantee that all apps are completely safe
options.B: Official stores provide a degree of screening
options.D: Users must still check the developer, permissions, reviews and authenticity

questions.explanation: Official stores provide a degree of screening and update mechanisms. Users must still check the developer, permissions, reviews and authenticity because harmful apps can sometimes appear there.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a reason to review app permissions?

options.A: All apps should have all permissions to function properly
options.B: Apps should receive only permissions necessary for their functions
options.C: Unnecessary access to contacts, microphone, camera, location or files increases privacy and security risks

questions.explanation: Apps should receive only permissions necessary for their functions. Unnecessary access to contacts, microphone, camera, location or files increases privacy and security risks.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a step to take when a phone is lost?

options.A: Post the phone number on social media
options.B: Use the device's official find/lock/wipe service
options.C: Contact the mobile operator to block the SIM

questions.explanation: When a phone is lost, use the device's official find/lock/wipe service; contact the mobile operator to block the SIM; change critical account passwords; notify the bank if payment access may be at risk; and report theft to police. In India, CEIR can be used to request blocking of a lost or stolen handset's IMEI after the prescribed process.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a function of CEIR?

options.A: Issuing Aadhaar numbers
options.B: Blocking lost or stolen mobile handsets
options.C: Tracing lost or stolen mobile handsets
options.D: Using IMEI to identify mobile devices

questions.explanation: CEIR is a Department of Telecommunications system used to help block and trace lost or stolen mobile handsets through their IMEI. Issuing Aadhaar numbers is a function of UIDAI.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a step to take after receiving a suspicious banking call?

options.A: Install any app the caller recommends
options.D: Contact the bank using the number on its official website, card or app

questions.explanation: After receiving a suspicious banking call, end the call, do not share credentials or install remote-access apps, and contact the bank using the number on its official website, card or app.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a risk of remote-access apps?

options.A: They automatically improve device security
options.B: Scammers may view or control the device
options.D: Scammers may access messages and OTPs

questions.explanation: Scammers may persuade victims to install remote-access apps and then view or control the device, potentially accessing banking apps, messages and OTPs. Remote-access apps do not automatically improve device security.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a safe social-media practice?

options.A: Sharing live location at all times

questions.explanation: Safe social-media practice includes using privacy controls, restricting public personal details, verifying friend requests, avoiding sharing live location or sensitive documents, enabling MFA and reporting impersonation or abuse.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a reason to enable automatic software updates?

options.A: They always break the system
options.B: They help install security fixes promptly
options.C: They reduce exposure to known vulnerabilities

questions.explanation: Automatic updates help install security fixes promptly and reduce exposure to known vulnerabilities. They do not always break the system.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a safe practice when using public charging stations?

options.A: Approving all data-access prompts
options.B: Preferring a wall charger and personal cable or a power bank
options.C: Using a data-blocking adapter where appropriate

questions.explanation: The safest way to use public charging stations is to prefer a wall charger and personal cable or a power bank. Use a data-blocking adapter where appropriate and avoid approving unexpected data-access prompts.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a safe practice for QR-code payments?

options.A: Entering your UPI PIN to receive money
options.B: Scanning only codes from trusted sources
options.C: Verifying the recipient and amount before authorising

questions.explanation: Users can protect themselves from QR-code fraud by scanning only codes from trusted sources, verifying the recipient and amount before authorising, rejecting unexpected collect requests and never entering a UPI PIN to receive money.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a step to take if a password is compromised?

options.A: Post about it on social media
options.B: Change it immediately on the affected service

questions.explanation: If a password is compromised, change it immediately on the affected service and anywhere it was reused; enable MFA; sign out other sessions; review recovery details and account activity; and contact the provider if access is lost.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a step to take if a user clicks a suspicious link but enters no information?

options.A: Continue browsing the site
options.D: Run a security scan if a file was downloaded

questions.explanation: If a user clicks a suspicious link but enters no information, close the page, do not download or approve anything, run a security scan if a file was downloaded, check browser/device activity and report the message if it appears malicious.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a step to take if a user has installed a suspicious app?

options.A: Continue using the app normally
options.B: Disconnect the device from sensitive activity
options.C: Uninstall the app if safe to do so

questions.explanation: If a user has installed a suspicious app, disconnect the device from sensitive activity, uninstall the app if safe to do so, run a trusted security scan, review permissions and account sessions, change important credentials from a clean device and seek technical or bank assistance if financial details may be exposed.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a characteristic of responsible disclosure?

options.A: Publishing a vulnerability on social media immediately
options.B: Reporting a vulnerability to the affected organisation
options.C: Allowing time for investigation and remediation

questions.explanation: Responsible disclosure is the process of reporting a security vulnerability to the affected organisation or authorised coordinator in a controlled manner, allowing time for investigation and remediation before public disclosure.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a component of cyber hygiene?

options.A: Ignoring software updates

questions.explanation: Cyber hygiene is the routine practice of maintaining secure digital behaviour, such as updates, backups, strong unique passwords, MFA, cautious browsing and access reviews. Ignoring software updates is not part of cyber hygiene.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a function of the Reserve Bank of India in cyber safety?

options.A: Issuing Aadhaar numbers
options.B: Issuing regulatory and security requirements for regulated financial entities
options.D: Promoting safe digital banking and payment practices

questions.explanation: RBI issues and supervises regulatory and security requirements for regulated financial entities and promotes safe digital banking and payment practices. Issuing Aadhaar numbers is a function of UIDAI.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a function of NPCI in digital payment safety?

options.A: Issuing Aadhaar numbers
options.B: Operating and developing retail payment systems such as UPI
options.C: Providing system-level rules and security measures
options.D: Supporting customer protection and fraud handling along with banks

questions.explanation: NPCI operates and develops retail payment systems such as UPI and provides system-level rules and security measures; banks and payment participants also have responsibilities for customer protection and fraud handling. Issuing Aadhaar numbers is a function of UIDAI.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a function of NIC?

options.A: Issuing Aadhaar numbers
options.B: Providing digital infrastructure, networks, data-centre and e-governance technology support to government organisations
options.C: NIC-CERT supporting cybersecurity for NIC's constituency

questions.explanation: NIC provides digital infrastructure, networks, data-centre and e-governance technology support to government organisations; NIC-CERT supports cybersecurity for NIC's constituency. Issuing Aadhaar numbers is a function of UIDAI.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a function of NCIIPC?

options.A: Issuing Aadhaar numbers
options.C: National nodal agency under Section 70A of the IT Act
options.D: Protecting computer resources whose incapacitation would have a debilitating impact on national security

questions.explanation: NCIIPC is the national nodal agency for protection of critical information infrastructure under Section 70A of the IT Act. Issuing Aadhaar numbers is a function of UIDAI.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a function of the Controller of Certifying Authorities (CCA)?

options.A: Issuing Aadhaar numbers
options.C: Overseeing the framework for digital signature certificates

questions.explanation: CCA licenses and regulates Certifying Authorities and oversees the framework for digital signature certificates under the IT Act. Issuing Aadhaar numbers is a function of UIDAI.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a function of the Cyber Swachhta Kendra?

options.A: Issuing Aadhaar numbers
options.D: Supporting detection and remediation of infected devices

questions.explanation: The Cyber Swachhta Kendra is the Government of India's botnet cleaning and malware analysis centre, which supports detection and remediation of infected devices and promotes cyber hygiene. Issuing Aadhaar numbers is a function of UIDAI.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a key difference between CERT-In and I4C?

options.A: CERT-In is under MHA; I4C is under MeitY
options.B: CERT-In coordinates technical cyber incident response; I4C coordinates cybercrime response and law-enforcement support
options.C: CERT-In focuses on cybersecurity incidents; I4C focuses on cybercrime coordination
options.D: CERT-In is the national cyber incident response agency; I4C is associated with MHA

questions.explanation: CERT-In is under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY); I4C is associated with the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA).

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a key difference between Aadhaar and PAN?

options.A: Both are issued by the same authority
options.B: Aadhaar is a UIDAI-issued resident identity number; PAN is a tax-related identifier issued by the Income Tax Department
options.C: Aadhaar is a 12-digit number; PAN is a 10-character alphanumeric number
options.D: Aadhaar is not proof of citizenship; PAN is a tax-related identifier

questions.explanation: Aadhaar is a UIDAI-issued resident identity number; PAN is a tax-related identifier issued by the Income Tax Department. They are issued by different authorities.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a key difference between a digital certificate and a digital signature?

options.A: Both are the same thing
options.B: A certificate binds an identity to a public key; a digital signature is a cryptographic operation used to verify origin and integrity
options.C: A certificate is issued by a Certifying Authority; a digital signature is created using a private key
options.D: A certificate is a credential; a digital signature is a cryptographic operation

questions.explanation: A certificate binds an identity to a public key; a digital signature is a cryptographic operation used to verify origin and integrity. They are not the same thing.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a type of cyber threat?

options.A: Software update

questions.explanation: A software update is a legitimate activity, not a cyber threat. Malware, phishing and ransomware are types of cyber threats.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a type of cyber attack?

options.A: Data backup

questions.explanation: A data backup is a legitimate activity, not a cyber attack. Phishing, DDoS and SQL injection are types of cyber attacks.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a type of data protection measure?

options.A: Publishing all personal data publicly

questions.explanation: Data protection measures include data minimisation, purpose limitation, data masking, anonymisation, pseudonymisation and encryption. Publishing all personal data publicly is the opposite of data protection.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a type of cybercrime?

options.A: Software installation

questions.explanation: Software installation is a legitimate activity, not a cybercrime. Online financial fraud, cyberstalking and cyberbullying are types of cybercrime.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a type of information security control?

options.A: Marketing control

questions.explanation: Information security controls include access control, firewalls, antivirus software, IDS, IPS and VPNs. Marketing control is not an information security control.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a type of authentication factor?

options.A: Something the user wants

questions.explanation: Authentication factors include something the user knows, something the user has and something the user is. 'Something the user wants' is not an authentication factor.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a type of access control model?

options.A: Marketing-based access control

questions.explanation: Access control models include role-based access control, principle of least privilege and discretionary access control. Marketing-based access control is not a recognised access control model.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a type of firewall?

options.A: Antivirus firewall

questions.explanation: Firewalls can be network-based, host-based or application-specific. 'Antivirus firewall' is not a standard type of firewall.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a type of malware detection technique?

options.A: Marketing analysis

questions.explanation: Antivirus software uses signatures, behaviour analysis and other detection techniques. Marketing analysis is not a malware detection technique.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a type of security patch?

options.A: Marketing patch

questions.explanation: A security patch is a software update designed to correct a vulnerability or security defect. Patches can apply to operating systems, applications or firmware. 'Marketing patch' is not a type of security patch.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a type of security assessment?

options.A: Marketing assessment

questions.explanation: Vulnerability assessment, penetration testing and security audit are types of security assessment. Marketing assessment is not a security assessment.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a stage of incident response?

options.A: Marketing

questions.explanation: The common stages of incident response are: Preparation; identification and analysis; containment; eradication; recovery; and post-incident review or lessons learned. Marketing is not a stage of incident response.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a characteristic of a security policy?

options.A: It guarantees complete protection from all threats
options.C: It governs how an organisation protects information and technology assets
options.D: It provides an approved framework for security practices

questions.explanation: A security policy is an approved set of rules and responsibilities governing how an organisation protects information and technology assets. No policy can guarantee complete protection from all threats.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a benefit of a security awareness programme?

options.A: Eliminating the need for technical security controls
options.C: Encouraging users to follow security procedures
options.D: Encouraging users to report suspicious activity

questions.explanation: A security awareness programme educates users to recognise threats, follow security procedures and report suspicious activity. It does not eliminate the need for technical security controls.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a function of a security log?

options.A: Encrypting data at rest

questions.explanation: A security log is a time-stamped record of system, application, network or user events used for monitoring, troubleshooting, auditing and investigation. Encrypting data at rest is a separate security control.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a function of a SOC?

options.A: Developing marketing strategies

questions.explanation: A SOC is a team or facility that continuously monitors, detects, analyses and coordinates responses to cybersecurity events. Developing marketing strategies is not a function of a SOC.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a function of a SIEM system?

options.A: Removing malware from endpoints
options.B: Collecting security logs from multiple sources

questions.explanation: A SIEM system collects and correlates security logs and events from multiple sources to support monitoring, alerting and investigation. Removing malware from endpoints is a function of antivirus software.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a characteristic of hashing?

options.A: It is reversible with the correct key
options.B: It converts data into a fixed-length digest
options.C: It is commonly used to check integrity
options.D: It is designed to be one-way

questions.explanation: Hashing converts data into a fixed-length digest using a hash function. It is commonly used to check integrity; secure password storage uses specialised salted password-hashing methods. A cryptographic hash is designed to be one-way and is not decrypted to recover the original data.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a component of a digital signature?

options.A: A scanned image of a handwritten signature

questions.explanation: A digital signature uses public-key cryptography to help verify the origin and integrity of an electronic message or document and support non-repudiation. It is not a scanned image of a handwritten signature.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a component of PKI?

options.A: Antivirus software

questions.explanation: PKI is a framework of digital certificates, public-key cryptography, policies and trusted authorities used to establish and manage digital identities and secure communications. Antivirus software is not a component of PKI.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a component of digital identity?

options.A: A person's physical fingerprints stored on paper

questions.explanation: Digital identity is the collection of electronic attributes and credentials used to represent, identify or authenticate a person, organisation, device or service online. Physical fingerprints stored on paper are not part of digital identity.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a valid identifier?

options.A: A password

questions.explanation: An identifier is a value used to distinguish an entity, such as a username, customer number, email address or identity number. A password is a credential used to prove identity, not an identifier.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a valid credential?

options.A: A username

questions.explanation: A credential is evidence used to prove identity or a claim, such as a password, smart card, digital certificate, passkey or biometric-based authentication token. A username is an identifier, not a credential.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a characteristic of Aadhaar?

options.A: It is a 16-digit number
options.B: It is a 12-digit random identity number
options.D: It is issued to residents of India after the prescribed enrolment and deduplication process

questions.explanation: Aadhaar is a 12-digit random identity number issued by UIDAI to residents of India after the prescribed enrolment and deduplication process. It is not a 16-digit number; a Virtual ID (VID) is a 16-digit number.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a valid use of a Virtual ID (VID) in Aadhaar?

options.A: As proof of Indian citizenship
options.D: As a temporary, revocable alternative to the Aadhaar number

questions.explanation: VID is a temporary, revocable 16-digit random number that can be used in place of the Aadhaar number for authentication or e-KYC where supported. Aadhaar and VID are not proof of Indian citizenship.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a characteristic of masked Aadhaar?

options.A: It conceals the last four digits
options.B: It conceals the first eight digits
options.C: Only the last four digits are visible
options.D: It is a version of the Aadhaar number

questions.explanation: Masked Aadhaar is a version in which the first eight digits of the Aadhaar number are concealed and only the last four digits are visible.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a characteristic of DigiLocker?

options.A: User-uploaded scans are automatically issuer-authenticated
options.B: It enables users to access, store and share authentic digital documents
options.C: Documents issued by registered issuers can be verified through the platform
options.D: It is a Government of India digital document platform

questions.explanation: Documents fetched or issued by registered issuers can be verified through the platform; a user-uploaded scan is not automatically an issuer-authenticated document.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a characteristic of a passkey?

options.A: It is vulnerable to phishing
options.B: It is based on public-key cryptography
options.C: It is generally unlocked using a device PIN or biometric method
options.D: It is a phishing-resistant sign-in credential

questions.explanation: A passkey is a phishing-resistant sign-in credential based on public-key cryptography, generally unlocked using a device PIN or biometric method. It is designed to resist phishing, not be vulnerable to it.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a characteristic of SSO?

options.A: It requires users to sign in separately to each application
options.B: It allows a user to authenticate once
options.C: It provides access to multiple connected applications
options.D: It is subject to the system's security controls

questions.explanation: SSO allows a user to authenticate once and access multiple connected applications without separately signing in to each one, subject to the system's security controls.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a characteristic of federated identity?

options.A: It requires users to create separate identities for each service
options.B: It allows trusted organisations or services to rely on an identity provider
options.C: It operates under agreed protocols and trust arrangements

questions.explanation: Federated identity allows trusted organisations or services to rely on an identity provider for authentication under agreed protocols and trust arrangements. It does not require users to create separate identities for each service.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a characteristic of IAM?

options.A: It only applies to government organisations
options.B: It includes policies, processes and technologies
options.C: It is used to create and manage digital identities

questions.explanation: IAM is the set of policies, processes and technologies used to create, manage, authenticate and control digital identities and their access rights. It applies to organisations of all types, not only government organisations.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a safe practice for Aadhaar usage?

options.A: Sharing Aadhaar details freely on social media
options.B: Using masked Aadhaar or VID where accepted
options.D: Using official UIDAI channels for services

questions.explanation: Precautions include sharing Aadhaar details only when legally or operationally required; using masked Aadhaar or VID where accepted; never disclosing OTPs or PINs; checking authentication notifications; and using official UIDAI channels for services.

questions.subject: Cybersecurity
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a characteristic of a strong password?

options.A: It is short and easy to remember

questions.explanation: A strong password is long, unique and difficult to guess. Prefer a long passphrase or randomly generated password; avoid reuse and predictable personal details.
